text:
emily: Heads-up — new pricing SKU revision (v4) will go live Mon 04/22 00:00 UTC. Main changes: consolidated compute SKUs, commit thresholds adjusted, legacy 'burst' credits removed. Summary + mapping doc: https://redwood.internal/pricing/v4. Sales: please scan open quotes closing in the next 30d and flag impacted deals here. 

raj: Got it. Do we have an export of affected quotes or a report? I can pull from CRM if someone can confirm mapping. pinging ana.

ana: For clarity: grandfathering is available for deals signed before go-live. Process: submit /dealdesk form with quote PDF + customer email. Window: 14 days post-release. Exceptions: strategic or BDU deals need revops+finance approval.

mike: Finance note — discounts >30% require CFO signoff. Also invoice code names change (old: PRC_SKU_*, new: PRC_V4_*). Revenue recognition unaffected but ops will need to update billing mappings.

sara: Legal: POC special terms OK up to 90 days at eval pricing if limited to non-prod and we add standard data-use clause. If customer asks for extra indemnities or residency guarantees, escalate to legal ops.

raj: We have one active POC with Acme asking for 35% off for first 3 months. Ana, can we fast-track?

ana: Send the quote link + POC SOW here or to deal-desk queue. We'll triage — likely need revops + finance. Aim: 24h turnaround for POC-level requests if docs complete.

emily: Quick config snippet for mapping old -> new SKUs for internal teams — please use when preparing quotes/attachments:
```
OLD_SKU_MAP = {
  'rwd.small': 'rwd.s1v4',
  'rwd.medium': 'rwd.s2v4',
  'rwd.large': 'rwd.s4v4'
}
```
Update the pricing console post-release; console will show both old and new SKUs for the 14-day overlap window. :calendar: 

sara: Also callout: if a customer has a security questionnaire that references storage/retention or key management, flag sec for review — there are a couple schema changes in v4. @sec-team please monitor.

mike: Commit tier change summary: tiers start at $50k/mo (was $40k/mo). Existing signed commits before go-live will be honored per ana's grandfathering rules.

raj: Thanks — I'll compile a list (Acme, BetaCorp, GammaLabs) and open deal-desk tickets tonight.

deploy-bot: Release scheduled: pricing-config v4 promoted to prod at 2024-04-22T00:00Z. All CI checks green. :rocket:

emily: Thanks everyone. If you have blocking enterprise customers or need an emergency exception, DM me and I'll coordinate the exception workflow. :thumbsup:
